sentences.l2: 很久以前，人们用风车磨面。
sentences.l1: A long time ago, people used windmills to grind flour.
When the wind blew, the windmill would turn.

sentences.l2: 现在，我们用太阳能板发电。
sentences.l1: Now, we use solar panels to generate electricity.
When the sun comes out, there is electricity.

sentences.l2: 这些方法很干净，不污染空气。
sentences.l1: These methods are very clean and do not pollute the air.

sentences.l2: 人们想出好办法，让风吹、太阳晒都能发电。
sentences.l1: People came up with good methods so that the wind blowing and the sun shining can both generate electricity.
The history of clean energy is long.

sentences.l2: 从风车到太阳能板，都在变好。
sentences.l1: From windmills to solar panels, everything is getting better.
There are more and more methods of generating electricity.
